description.value: Fierce Fish Ocean Adventures is an Indigenous-owned and operated private boat tour company led by Captain Jay, whose roots are with the Saddle Lake Cree Nation. Operating from Quadra Island and Campbell River in the Discovery Islands, FFOA offers fully personalized fishing charters, whale watching, and scenic tours for groups of up to six guests aboard a 22-foot Corvina 225. A touring cyclist visiting the area who wants to experience the Salish Sea wildlife — including whales and coastal scenery — would find this a distinctive, locally rooted option.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is fully available and describes Fierce Fish Ocean Adventures as a private ocean tour operator based on Quadra Island and Campbell River, BC. No OSM tags are present beyond the name, URL, and coordinates. The website makes no mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, or any cyclist-specific amenities — it is a marine tour boat operation with departures from harbour/marina locations, so all amenity fields default to null. The business is clearly active and operating with an up-to-date safety policy dated August 2025.
concerns: No OSM tags present — record appears to be a manually added stub with coordinates and URL only; no address or phone number available from OSM or the website contact page.

Departure locations listed on website are Quathiaski Cove Harbour (Quadra Island) and Fisherman's Wharf Marina, Campbell River — OSM coordinates (49.899, -125.835) appear to correspond to Quadra Island area, which is plausible for the home base.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, active, publicly accessible attraction operating in the Discovery Islands region; an interesting experiential option for touring cyclists exploring Vancouver Island and Quadra Island.
enrichment_extras.notes: Tours operate year-round per the visitor guide. Departures from two locations: Quathiaski Cove Rd, Quathiaski Cove, BC V0P 1N0 (Quadra Island) and 705 Island Hwy, Campbell River, BC V9W 2C2 (Fisherman's Wharf Marina).
